purpose: Continue outcomes of frozen weekly research cohorts without new entries or parameter tuning.
tracked: Only already-filled OPEN records in the original cohort; original terminal results remain immutable.
pending: Unfilled PENDING at the week boundary remains censored; no assumed future entry, expiry or capital release.
cohort: First successful completed seven-day research artifact on main; never replace with a later re-optimized cohort.
costs: Unchanged original 5bps fee and 2bps adverse slippage each side, normalized by net stop risk.
gaps: Require consecutive closed 15M bars from original period end; never skip a missing bar to claim TP.
ambiguous: Same-bar TP and SL remain AMBIGUOUS; no intrabar ordering inference.
sample_accounting: Follow-up updates the same cohort; daily partial reports never add independent samples.
portfolio: Re-evaluate the original capped portfolio with unchanged creation/fill events; no later entries or future-profit sizing.
dataset: RETROSPECTIVE_OUTCOME_FOLLOWUP, not captured-live Shadow fills or actual execution.
